# Hong Kong public holiday regression fixtures

The English and Traditional Chinese files are the unmodified Hong Kong Government
1823 calendars downloaded on 6 November 2026, containing 2025–2027 holidays:

- https://www.1823.gov.hk/common/ical/en.ics
- https://www.1823.gov.hk/common/ical/tc.ics

Expected 2026 and 2027 dates are independently checked against the gazetted lists:

- https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202505/16/P2025051300353p.htm
- https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202605/15/P2026051400300.htm
